title: Grenada walking tour
text: Christian was a fantastic guide and brought the city to life for us.  I highly recommend this tour!!!
author: scott_m

title: Worth it.
text: We couldn't get tickets on our own and hired this tour. We discovered interesting places within the walls of the Alhambra and then the continuous tour of the beautiful gardens of the Carmen de los Martires. Our guide with his explanations offered us a version of Granada that we did not know and we were pleasantly surprised.
author: Ventas2204
